title: Alexa Device Unresponsive
shortDescription: Echo device does not respond to wake word or app.
fullDescription:
An unresponsive Echo device either lost its network connection, encountered a firmware hang, or has its microphone muted.

Check the mute button (red ring means mic off), verify WiFi, and reboot the device.

fixSteps.title: Check mic mute
fixSteps.instruction: Press the microphone button on top to unmute.

faq.a: Yes, easy to hit when moving the device.

title: Alexa Device Offline
shortDescription: Echo shows offline in Alexa app.
fullDescription:
An Echo showing offline has lost its connection to Amazon's cloud. Typically a WiFi drop, router issue, or AWS outage.

Reboot router and Echo, re-enter WiFi if needed.

title: Alexa Something Went Wrong
fullDescription:
Alexa says Something went wrong when it fails to fetch a response from Amazon cloud or when a skill returns an error.

Repeat the request, check internet, and check skill status if specific to a skill.

fixSteps.title: Repeat request
fixSteps.instruction: Try the request again after a moment.

faq.a: Check your network and reboot device.

title: Alexa Audio Error 10:1:0:0:4
fullDescription: This error code indicates Alexa failed to stream audio due to an internal cache or service communication issue. Often resolved by rebooting the device and clearing the music provider's cache.

fixSteps.title: Deregister/register
fixSteps.instruction: In Alexa app remove and re-add the device.

faq.a: Internal error code from the audio pipeline.

title: Alexa Setup Error
fullDescription: Setup errors occur when the Alexa app cannot complete the provisioning flow. Common causes include phone dropping the Echo's setup AP, wrong WiFi password, and Bluetooth permission not granted.

fixSteps.title: Hold Action button
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Action button for 25 seconds to enter setup again.

fixSteps.title: Grant location/Bluetooth
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure Alexa app has location and Bluetooth permissions.

title: Alexa WiFi Error
fullDescription: WiFi errors appear when Echo can't authenticate or reach the network. Check credentials, router band, and security settings.

fixSteps.title: Re-enter password
fixSteps.instruction: In Alexa app update WiFi password.

faq.a: Newer Echos yes, older models require WPA2.

title: Alexa Spotify Error
fullDescription: Alexa-Spotify integration fails when account linking expires or when Spotify has regional outages. Re-link the account in the Alexa app.
symptoms: Alexa says can't connect to Spotify

fixSteps.title: Re-link Spotify
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Music & Podcasts > Spotify > Unlink, then re-link.

faq.a: Spotify Free plays on Echo but without device selection.

title: Alexa Routine Not Running
fullDescription:
Routines may fail to run due to incorrect trigger time zone, disabled routine, or the trigger device being offline.

Edit the routine to verify trigger and action devices.

fixSteps.title: Check routine
fixSteps.instruction: Open the routine in Alexa app and confirm time zone/device.

faq.a: Yes, tap the play icon next to the routine.

title: Alexa Timer Not Working
fullDescription:
Timers fail if Do Not Disturb is on, the device is muted/volume low, or the device is offline.

Ensure DND is off and volume is audible.

fixSteps.title: Disable DND
fixSteps.instruction: Say Alexa, disable do not disturb.

faq.a: Only if Alexa app notifications are enabled.

title: Alexa Alarm Error
fullDescription: Similar to timers, alarms may not fire if DND, Away mode, or volume are blocking. Custom sound alarms can also fail if the music source is unlinked.

fixSteps.title: Check alarms list
fixSteps.instruction: In app > Reminders & Alarms, verify alarm is enabled.

videoSearchQuery: Alexa alarm not going off fix

title: Alexa Drop In Failed
shortDescription: Drop In call fails to connect.
fullDescription: Drop In uses Alexa's communications feature. Failures can occur when contact permissions are off, target device is offline, or privacy settings disallow Drop In.

causes.cause: Drop In not enabled on target

fixSteps.title: Enable Drop In
fixSteps.instruction: Device settings > Communications > Drop In > Allow.

title: Alexa Calling Error
shortDescription: Calls cannot be placed or received.
fullDescription: Calling via Alexa requires a verified phone number, contacts sync, and working WiFi. Errors indicate one of those is missing.

fixSteps.title: Verify phone
fixSteps.instruction: In Alexa app Communicate tab, verify number.

title: Echo Show Screen Error
shortDescription: Echo Show screen is black, frozen, or distorted.
fullDescription:
Screen issues can stem from firmware glitches or hardware failure. A 15-second power-button hold restarts the device.

Persistent distortion may indicate panel damage.

faq.a: Can occur with static images; use photo frame mode.

title: Echo Kids Edition Error
shortDescription: Echo Kids features not working correctly.
fullDescription: Kids features require Amazon Kids+ subscription and a kids profile. Errors occur when profile lapses or content filters block a request.

fixSteps.title: Check subscription
fixSteps.instruction: Log in to Amazon Kids and verify status.

faq.q: Can I switch to adult profile?
faq.a: Yes via Alexa app profile switcher.

title: Alexa Music Not Playing
shortDescription: Echo fails to play requested music.
fullDescription: Music may not play if the requested service isn't default, the subscription has lapsed, or streaming rights are limited. Default music service is set in Alexa app settings.

faq.q: Can I specify service per request?
